# J.Crew

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 20 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

J.Crew is a public clothing shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.jcrew.com](https://www.jcrew.com) on 2026-11-22. The browser landed on the Singapore storefront, [https://www.jcrew.com/sg/](https://www.jcrew.com/sg/). Prices read SGD. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, the women's clothing grid, one public product, and Our Story were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

`catalog.json` and `webapps-manifest.json` were left alone. `login-extracted` stays `not-started`.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
